hits.name: ecoinometrics
hits.text:
Bitcoin isn't trading like a tech stock this year. 

Over the past 12 months the Nasdaq is up 15% and Bitcoin is down 26%. 

This year the “leveraged Nasdaq” label only applies on the way down. https://t.co/TE1Xz3SDsm
hits.hook: Bitcoin isn't trading like a tech stock this year.
hits.draft_en:
Nasdaq +15% over 12 months. $BTC -26%.

So it isn't trading like a tech stock. Only the downside matches.

That asymmetry is exactly what a rule-based exposure should address.
hits.draft_quote_en: Asymmetry: the "leveraged Nasdaq" label only applies on the way down. Have you tested a simple trend filter on this?
